measured_geometry.method: Native TikZ text-node south-west/north-east anchors emitted during compilation, plus actual rendered-image inspection.

legacy_checker_adjudication.palette_finding: The heuristic counts separate tints of the same base hue as distinct colors. Three bright base hues are explicitly requested by the user; white and gray are neutrals.
legacy_checker_adjudication.overlap_finding: Its generic text estimates default to 0.75 cm height and approximate character widths without using the actual 8.3 pt font metrics. Specific alleged overlaps were checked against native TikZ bounds and rendered images.
legacy_checker_adjudication.resolution: All actual overlaps and overflows were fixed. The remaining generic heuristic findings are documented false positives or user-authorized palette overrides, not unexamined passes.

scientific_limits: The inverse effective-client-count priority is a design assumption, not a proven causal relationship with forgetting.
The correction loss is soft and does not guarantee that accuracy or classification loss cannot deteriorate.
An architecture diagram does not establish an advantage over simple client weighting or simple historical retention.
This is a computation overview, not a packet-by-packet communication diagram; raw images stay local and candidate feedback is recomputed locally.
